articles.summary: Leading Online Firearms Platform Adds Bitcoin, USDC and USDT Payment Options to Modernize Commerce Experience While Maintaining Full Regulatory Compliance GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW), an online retailer of firearms, ammunition and related accessories, today announced that the Company has begun accepting cryptocurrency payments on GrabAGun.com . To our knowledge, GrabAGun is the first major firearms retailer to support Bitcoin (BTC), USD Coin (USDC), and Tether (USDT). The new payment options further cement GrabAGun's position as the industry's most forward-thinking and technology-focused platform. This strategic initiative reflects GrabAGun's commitment to modernizing the digital purchasing experience for firearms enthusiasts and attracting younger, digitally native consumers who represent a growing segment of the firearms market. articles.title: GrabAGun Becomes First Major Firearms Retailer to Accept Bitcoin Payments
